t: A Renesas microcontroller with Ethernet, CAN FD, and fast USB for connected projects.
steps: Buy a SparkFun Thing Plus RA6M5 from SparkFun or an Arduino Portenta C33 from the Arduino store. Both were on sale for about 20 to 25 US dollars.
Get a USB-C cable to connect it to your computer.
Add the Arduino Renesas board package with the Boards Manager.
Pick your board and the right port in the Tools menu.
Upload the Blink example and watch the LED flash.
Try a Qwiic sensor example next, or the MicroPython port on the Portenta C33.
meta: Wild Open. From $19.95. A few stores.
